messages.subject: R-Simmer Tutorial
parts:
Hi, everybody.

I´m a new user in the R-simmer environment, I am a former user from JaamSim (a great GUI DES software), and I want to change to the R-Simmer. 

What the best way to learning and understand this package usage. I´m are studying the http://r-simmer.org/index.html articles tutorials (on going), but anybody can suggest me more learning resources about this great package?

Best Regards!

Leonardo

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] R-Simmer Tutorial
parts:
Hi Leonardo,

Welcome to this community. Those articles are the main resource. In
case you were wondering, this is a relatively young package and there
are no books; yet. There is a journal paper though which will be added
to the list of articles as soon as it gets published (it has been
already accepted). You can find the e-print on arXiv:
https://arxiv.org/abs/1705.09746

Of course, any questions, thoughts, bug reports or requests for
improvements are always welcome.

Regards,
Iñaki
